Scope: Public logical prefix support is an input contract. Pruned branches are replaced by exact public zero ciphertexts without secret-dependent decisions; full and pruned cases have identical useful payload. Paired unit-power sweep: all powers share identical trial input ciphertext and cryptographic keys; input unit is fixed at power1, internal/output units vary. Stage diagnostics are separate deterministic reruns outside online timing. Full coefficient split into N/n branches, one independently selectable complex message per branch, only public active branches bootstrapped in prune-only mode, all branches merged, one return KS. SSE h32; shared leaf main keys, independent evaluator buffers per branch, schedule-independent rounding seeds. AllLeafBootstrapSeconds is wall time; SumBranchSeconds sums overlapping branch wall durations. Serial verification uses each identical trial input and keys; parallel mode uses two independent EvalMod lanes, outside parallel timings. Online timing excludes keygen/encryption/decryption/oracle diagnostics. Finite-sample experiment; no security certification.
